ratings_why.fun: Gust Pages win turn 1-3 fights, the hand-held Late reserve grows each turn through Black Cloud and the Heron, and three different Tier 6 finishes give a curve I'd happily draft; capped mid-game growth keeps it from an 8.
ratings_why.distinct: An 8 because the hand fights as a reserve the enemy's Start of Combat can't touch, and Lady High Pressure holds and releases the whole fight; no current tribe plays on timing or the hand like this.

verdict_why: v3 closed the rules gaps; what's left are ideas and the owner's balance eye, so more rounds would make it different rather than better.

points.text: A golden Swift Couriers (or golden Mrs Foul) can't be played, so its triple Discover never fires. Let it Discover when it arrives, or when the golden is made.

Squall's permanent growth at Tiers 3-5 is small capped drips (Windhover, Föhn), so the board may trail uncapped scalers until the Tower. One Tier 5 piece that turns the Gust count into permanent stats would smooth the curve.
Dew-Pond Heron on the leftmost Late unit makes holding the Duke a real choice each turn; keep it, and consider letting hand order be shown clearly while recruiting.
In a full Squall comp the Tower reaches 6-8 faces easily, about +8/+8 to every board unit a turn. Hot but on the guide's top; leave it for the owner to tune.

standouts.why: Holding every Gust and arrival then releasing them doubled is a real capstone, and front or back row placement decides when the storm breaks.
A Late unit that grows with the attack count, fed in hand by the Heron and Black Cloud, gives the Late build a clear payoff.
Pointing at the last unit played turns play order into a decision every turn from Tier 2.

weakest.why: Flat 1-2 gold for a count the comp hits anyway; the tribe's only economy and the least interesting card.
Mr Fair's swap with Mrs Foul is fiddly for small value; the End of Turn +1/+1 does most of the work.
Up to +2/+2 a fight is a thin seed, though it now rewards spreading Gusts.

flags.note: Late units in hand are extra bodies the enemy can't target; a hand of Couriers, Bora and the Duke can make 10-11 unit fights against 7.
Eight faces is reachable, about 112 permanent stats a turn (224 golden); at the guide's top, worth the owner's eye.
With the Steward and goldens, held Gusts go x4 to x9 in one fight; fight-only, but one-sided wipes are likely.
